messages:
michelle_pm: ACME follow-up: they want a guided "Optimize Advisor" pilot that recommends batching, cache, and quantization per-route and exposes a simple UI to accept/reject suggestions. They need clear launch gates.

dave_eng: For pilot keep it lightweight: heuristics-based recommender + one-click apply that toggles runtime flags. No autoscale of configs yet.

sara_ml: Eval safety is critical. Plan: every recommendation is accompanied by estimated quality delta from a short offline eval on customer corpus. If estimated drop >1.5% we mark as "needs-human-review" and block one-click.

nina_cs: ACME insists on per-route SLO overrides; chat route p99 <=120ms, batch route throughput >500 tok/s. They also asked for an "undo" that reverts configs per-route for 24h.

tim_sre: Ops requirements: feature-flag per-customer and per-route, canary rollout 10/50/100, sampling when recommendation applied (default 10% for 1h) and global kill switch. Need metrics: applied_recs, revert_count, sample_capture_rate.

jenna_product: Proposed minimal acceptance: (A) UI shows suggested config + expected perf/quality delta; (B) automated offline eval runs in <30m and publishes estimated deltas; (C) canary toggle + revert works; (D) docs and runbook. Suggest 2-sprint pilot.

dave_eng: Runtime snippet (pilot):```yaml
advisor:
  enabled: true
  mode: heuristics
  ui_apply_oneclick: true
  default_sampling_pct: 10
routes:
  chat:
    suggested_batch: 1-8
    suggested_quant: none|int8
    max_wait_ms: 20
```

sara_ml: Alert rule prototype: if post-apply eval shows relative_drop(metric="rouge_L") > 0.015 then send alert "advisor_quality_regress" and auto-sample 100% for 1h.

michelle_pm: Prioritization: pilot-tier. Keep int4 out. Timeline: sprint1 = heuristic recommender + UI mock + offline eval; sprint2 = one-click apply + canary + sampling + docs.

nina_cs: ACME: pls include export of applied config history and simple "revert" API. They want a record for audits.

tim_sre: We'll log config history and include a revert endpoint (per-route). Also add TTL on reverts to prevent stale toggles.

ci-bot: Deploy queued: feature/advisor-lite -> staging (#8102)

michelle_pm: Action items: dave - implement heuristic engine + apply API; sara - eval runner + thresholds; tim - canary + revert API; jenna - PRD + customer comms; nina - confirm audit format with ACME. Update here when ready.

all: ACK."
